infotexts.entitydescription.combatmultitool: Two-handed ricocheting energy-ring emitter and shield. Requires Lua for Barotrauma. One cell or fuel rod powers weapons, shield, light and tools. Quality grants 1/2/3/4 bounces. Players disable NPC damage to weld/cut. Extinguisher takes priority over firing. Bots automatically select combat or one technical function for their actual task. While held and powered, grants +2 to all five skills every 5 minutes; shared progress with the composite multi-tool.
infotexts.entitydescription.Multi-toolSET: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank. With a usable fuel rod, holding it grants +2 to all five skills every 5 minutes. Passive training requires Lua for Barotrauma and shares progress with Aegis.
infotexts.entitydescription.wrenchscrewdrivertwoin: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisheadset: Standard-range radio with one battery-cell slot. While equipped in the headset slot, spends energy on pressure protection and gradual health regeneration. The red field indicates protection or healing power use, not incoming injury. A full standard cell provides about 20 seconds of pressure protection alone. Supports mod afflictions; Neurotrauma is optional. Radio works without a battery. Requires client and server LuaCs.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisheadsetmk2: Advanced regenerative headset. Also absorbs native attacks from every direction, spending battery power according to incoming strength. Insufficient power lets part of the damage through. The red field indicates protection or regeneration; flicker alone does not mean health loss. Impacts create a stronger flash. Medical mods are optional. Requires client and server LuaCs.
